content:
maria: Hey team — have a 6-month enterprise POC with AcmeCorp. They asked for a 25% seat discount + commit to 250k tokens/month. CPQ shows the Special Term flag but routing didn't kick. Need routing check; urgent for renewal call tomorrow. cc @devon

liam: Send the SFDC opp id and a screenshot of CPQ fields. Which pricebook?

maria: opp: 0067F00000XcPq1 — pricebook: enterprise-2026. Screenshot uploaded to opp notes. Billing term: 6mo prepaid. Want to confirm if this meets auto-approve thresholds.

devon: grabbing opp. Thresholds: discounts <=20% auto-approve for AE tier; >20% needs Deal Desk review. Also commits >=200k tokens require finance approval. So this is 25% + 250k -> manual flow. Tagging @deal-desk-bot to start routing.

deal-desk-bot: Routing started -> Created DD ticket DD-12847. Assigned: devon. SLA: 8 business hours for initial response.

maria: Is there any CPQ field we can tweak to force the right routing? The auto rules should have fired.

liam: Looks like CPQ `discount_category` is null. If you set `discount_category=promo` CPQ rule bypasses and triggers manual review; that's not what we want. Ideally need `discount_category=standard` and `override_reason` set to "POC commit" for faster review.

maria: Copying snippet to update via API:
```json
{
  "opportunity_id": "0067F00000XcPq1",
  "discount_pct": 25,
  "discount_category": "standard",
  "override_reason": "POC_commit_6mo"
}
```

devon: We'll keep manual path. To speed it: propose temporary approval matrix — if commit>=200k AND discount<=30% AND legal sign-off present -> expedited finance review (4 biz hours). Can we add that to Deal Desk routing rules?

samira: Legal can pre-clear standard PII clauses. I'll sign the legal checklist tonight. If legal ok, finance has previously ok'd similar POCs under pre-approved MSA v3.

devon: I'll update routing rule in Zendesk/Hub to include new expedite predicate; need QA window. If urgent, I'll manually escalate to finance. @liam can you confirm billing term is prepay and revenue recognition notes included?

liam: Yes prepay, revenue_schedule = up-front. Added note to opp.

devon: Manual escalation done -> Pinged finance. Updated DD-12847: labels [expedite, prepay, legal-cleared]. ETA finance response: 2.5 biz hours.

maria: Amazing. One last ask — can we patch CPQ template to surface `commit_units` and `discount_category` as required fields to avoid future misses?

devon: Good RFC. I'll open a ticket with eng-cpq for a small UI tweak. Tagging #eng-platform for visibility.

deal-desk-bot: DD-12847 status updated -> finance approved with special term: 22% discount (counter-offer), commit confirmed 250k tokens/month, legal to finalize signature. Approved by: finance_lead, dealdesk_devon. Closing comment: "Advise AE to accept or escalate to CRO."

maria: Thanks all — will update Acme during tomorrow call. :tada:
